_description: REFERENCE ONLY — this file is inert documentation, not live configuration. This stage does not apply it to the current session. It is a snippet an END USER copies into their OWN user-scope Claude Code settings (e.g. ~/.claude/settings.json or a project's .claude/settings.local.json) when running the kimi-atlas plugin against a DIFFERENT target repo of theirs, so the plugin's backbone Bash calls (script invocations under the plugin root, and the isolated git-worktree rollback machinery) do not trigger a permission prompt on every single call.
_usage: Copy the value of the "permissions" key below into the "permissions" object of your own settings.json (merging with any rules you already have) — do not copy the _description/_usage fields themselves.
